@brief This file is created by EA, it should practically hold 'typedef' alias to function pointers. The 'typedef' aliases can be used in EA UML as a 'delegate class', thus enabling their use as UML attribute. Care has been taken by the UML architect (author) to define 'function pointer' and 'typedef' with exact same name. Hence, from the C compiler standpoint, the 'typedef' does not need to be defined here, it can simply use the function pointer prototypes directly. Thus this file should contain nothing other than the inclusion of the actual file where function pointer prototypes are present.
